'''Infocapsules''' were data storage devices containing decryption codes. Using the codes allowed an individual to decode hidden information in a broadcast. [[Adana Vermor]], an [[Imperial Economics Advisor]], hid data in the [[Imperial Economic Update]] segment on [[Imperial HoloVision]]. Individuals entrusted with infocapsules could read the information.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
